title: Zamorano et al. measured out-of-field thermal neutron fluence, TrueBeam and Elekta, 15 MV

source_replication_archive.filename: Replication data for Out-of-field thermal neutron characterization with thin 3D-silicon detectors in Varian TrueBeam and Elekta Synergy LINACs(1).zip

measurement_contract.normalization: neutrons cm^-2 per Gy delivered photon dose at dmax
measurement_contract.positions: P1–P5; P1 for TrueBeam described as 2 m from isocenter and 1.2 m above floor in the paper.

extraction_notes: Thermal fluence values are direct numeric values from the paper table. PDD data are direct numeric values from the Digital.CSIC replication text file. Experimental and PHITS-simulated rows are explicitly separated by evidence_type; no simulated value is promoted to experimental truth.
